tip.title: How to study
tip.text: Learn the examples aloud, complete the quiz, then produce your own answer without copying the model.

sections.title: Core words and phrases
sections.description: Flip each card, listen, and create one personal example.

cards.definition: Travelling alone was a useful experience.
My new job is very different.
The city centre is crowded at noon.
The village is quiet and peaceful.

tip.title: Recall practice
tip.text: Cover the English term, read the Vietnamese meaning, and retrieve the full phrase from memory.

sections.title: Grammar bridge
sections.description: Master the structures that connect this A2 module to the next stage.

points.title: Comparatives
points.function: Use -er or more to compare two things.
examples: The train is faster than the bus.

points.title: Superlatives
points.function: Use the ...-est or the most for one item in a group.
examples: That was the most exciting trip.

points.title: Present perfect: experience
points.function: Use have/has + past participle with ever, never and recently.

tip.title: Accuracy first
tip.text: Notice the verb form in every example, then change the subject or time expression to make a new sentence.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.description: Choose the best answer, then read the explanation.

questions.prompt: This route is ___ than the old one.
questions.explanation: Use shorter than to compare two routes.
Use the most popular for the superlative.
Present perfect needs the past participle eaten.
Never describes an experience that has not happened.

questions.prompt: The village is quieter ___ the city.
She ___ recently started a new course.
questions.explanation: She takes has in the present perfect.

tip.title: Use the clue
tip.text: Look for time expressions, the subject, and words before or after the gap before choosing.

sections.title: Build a spoken answer
sections.description: Answer each question aloud. Aim for a clear answer plus one reason or detail.
questions: Compare your town with another place.
What is the best trip you have ever taken?
What new thing have you tried recently?
sections.sampleAnswer: My town is quieter than Hanoi, but Hanoi is more convenient. The best place I have ever visited is Da Nang because the beaches are beautiful.

tip.title: Speak in layers
tip.text: Start with a direct answer, add a reason, then give one example or detail.

sections.title: Independent writing
sections.description: Recommend one of two places to a visitor.

prompt.situation: Compare transport, atmosphere and price, then mention your own experience.
prompt.referenceAnswer: My town is quieter than Hanoi, but Hanoi is more convenient. The best place I have ever visited is Da Nang because the beaches are beautiful.

tip.title: Final check
tip.text: Check verb forms, word order, spelling, and whether every sentence helps answer the task.
